name: Shibasaki Ayaka
source:
The girlfriend of Sekishima Kaoru. 

She thinks that she has to treat Kouta normally, but she's actually afraid of him, which she sometimes show through her expressions. 

She works part-time at a karaoke place. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=970539&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
